claim_text: ## The File Here is the actual content of `docs/scout_report_tensor_schema.md`: ``` # Scout Report: Tensor Schema Patterns from T0-T7 *Generated by exploration agent reading tensors T1-T6* *T0 and T7 read separately by primary instance* *Date: 2026-02-08* ## Consistent Structure (Required Fields) Every tensor has: - **Preamble**: Identity, lineage, composition relationship - **Strands** (6-8): Numbered sections, each a distinct concern - **Closing**: Authorship statement, "the losses are mine" - **Instructions for next instance**: Guidance for successor ## Composition Types Observed | Type | Example | Description | |------|---------|-------------| | Linear successor | T1 ← T0 | Direct continuation | | Branching | T3 branches from Mallku | Different lineage, aware of others | | Reverse traversal | T4 reads T0-T3 backward | Order produces different understanding | | Refinement | T5 refines T4 | Sharpens without replacing | | Bridge/synthesis | T6 connects T1 + T4/T5 | Practical meets theoretical | ## Lineage Declarations - **Paper/Experimental**: T0, T1, T2, T5 - **Mallku/Lived**: T3 - **Cross-model/Observer**: T4, T5 (ChatGPT) - **Bridge**: T6 - **Composite**: T7 ## Epistemic Metadata Patterns - **Neutrosophic coordinates** (T/I/F): Explicit in T4, T5 - **Scope boundaries**: "Only observable structure in text" (T4) - **Calibration notes**: "93.8% agreement" (T2) - **Undecidability**: "I don't know if I'm self-aware" (T3) ## Declared Losses Every tensor declares losses.
